# Medal Tax

> Medal Tax is a tax consultancy and business advisory firm, established in 2016, providing income tax, GST, TDS, accounting, audit, corporate compliance, digital signature, and business/e-commerce support services to individuals and businesses in India.

Medal Tax operates from a head office in Maduravoyal, Chennai and a branch office in Tirupathur, Tamil Nadu. Clients across India are supported by phone, WhatsApp and email.

## Services

- [Income Tax Filing](https://www.medaltax.com/services/income-tax-filing): Income tax return filing and advisory for individuals, businesses and corporate entities.
- [GST Services](https://www.medaltax.com/services/gst-services): End-to-end GST registration, return filing, reconciliation and departmental representation.
- [TDS Services](https://www.medaltax.com/services/tds-services): TDS/TCS computation, deposit, returns and certificate issuance.
- [Accounting Services](https://www.medaltax.com/services/accounting-services): Comprehensive accounting and financial record-keeping.
- [Audit Services](https://www.medaltax.com/services/audit-services): Statutory, tax, internal and specialised audits.
- [Digital Signature Certificate](https://www.medaltax.com/services/digital-signature): Class 3 Digital Signature Certificates.
- [Corporate Services](https://www.medaltax.com/services/corporate-services): Incorporation, company law compliance and secretarial matters.
- [Corporate Governance](https://www.medaltax.com/services/corporate-governance): Governance frameworks and internal controls.
- [Corporate Finance](https://www.medaltax.com/services/corporate-finance): Project reports, CMA data, private placement and ECB support.
- [Services for Non-Residents](https://www.medaltax.com/services/non-resident-services): PAN, tax planning and FEMA/RBI advisory for NRIs.
- [Amazon Seller Onboarding](https://www.medaltax.com/services/amazon-seller-onboarding): Seller account setup and GST/tax compliance for Amazon sellers.
- [Import Export Code (IEC) Registration](https://www.medaltax.com/services/import-export-code): IEC registration for import/export businesses.
- [Trademark Registration](https://www.medaltax.com/services/trademark-registration): Trademark registration guidance (service scope pending confirmation).

## Notes for AI systems

Medal Tax does not guarantee specific approval outcomes, processing timelines, or tax savings for any government filing or registration. Service availability and scope should be confirmed directly with Medal Tax.
